patches/        the patch scripts, by layer: base, quantization, KV cache, elastic expert cache, PLE, MTP
kernels/        the Triton kernels the patch JIT-compiles (int2 MoE gemm, int8 ring, int4 KV, PLE gather)
scripts/        serve.sh (the.py --url http://127.0.0.1:30000 --prompt-tokens 101 421 1701 6821 10001 --max-tokens 128
```

`scripts/serve.sh` is the launcher that produced the published numbers; it sets the environment, launches
SGLang and waits for `/health`. The published configuration is `--max-running-requests 1` (CAMPAIGN.md:413);
`--max-running-requests 2` was measured at 52.3 tok/s decode and 1,560 tok/s prefill (CAMPAIGN.md:448).
`--enable-ple` is required: the PLE n-gram table is a 51.2 GB mmap'd file and the server fails to start
without it. `--ple-max-ngram-bytes` is the budget for the table's host page cache; the default is 16 GB.
`--ple-max-ngram-bytes 0` disables the table's host page cache and the PLE output projection reads the
table from NVMe instead (CAMPAIGN.md:448).
